channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Man boards cruise ship to run 7 marathons in 7 days
item.description: ABC News' Danny New interviews a Scottish ultra trail runner who ran seven marathons in seven days during his Mediterranean cruise.

item.title: 70 marathon runners evacuated after heavy rain stranding
item.description: About 70 runners and volunteers in Utah's Moab 240 ultramarathon were stranded overnight after a significant storm.

item.title: New manhole mystery reported on Manhattan's Upper West Side
item.description: Three men were observed entering a sewer system, the latest in a series of incidents across New York City.

item.title: Vatican says Pope Leo to have surgery after lung lesion found
item.description: The American pope has no known prior health issues and is described as physically active.
